description: Server-side copy of any HTML doc the user can read (their own OR shared with them) into their own farm under a new name. THE fast path for building a modified version of an existing doc: content never passes through your context — duplicate in ~1s, then use patch_doc for the differences. Vastly faster than get_doc_html + re-hosting.

account.description: Email address of the farm to act on. Omit for the signed-in farm. Only a connected account is accepted; call list_accounts to see which.

new_name.description: Name for the copy in the user's farm.

slug.description: Source share-link slug or full URL. Alternative to doc_name.

name: duplicate_doc
title: Duplicate a doc server-side
